duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa bismillaahi kharajnaa, wa 'alallaahi Rabbinaa tawakkalnaa
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah we enter, in the Name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alallaahi, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah. Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khabaa'ith
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from male and female impure spirits.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim; Sahih Bukhari 142; Sahih Muslim 375

duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.transliteration: Ghufraanaka
duas.meaning: I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah. (If forgotten at the start: Bismillaahi fee awwalihi wa aakhirihi.)

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee at'amanee haadhaa wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah Who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabba haadhihid-da'watit-taammah, was-salaatil-qaa'imah, aati Muhammadanil-waseelata wal-fadeelah, wab'ath-hu maqaaman mahmoodanil-ladhee wa'adtah
duas.meaning: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad ﷺ the intercession and favour, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him.

duas.arabic: Repeat the words of the muezzin, and when he says حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ / حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ say: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
duas.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah (at Hayya 'alas-Salah / Hayya 'alal-Falah)
duas.meaning: Repeat the Adhan; at the Hayya calls say: there is no might nor power except with Allah. Then send salawat and make the after-Adhan dua.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim; Sahih Bukhari 611; Sahih Muslim 385

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa la-munqaliboon
duas.meaning: Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it (by our efforts). Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma baarik lahum fee maa razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum
duas.meaning: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allaahumma amootu wa ahyaa
duas.meaning: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live. (Also recite Ayat al-Kursi and the last two surahs as authentically taught.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim; Sahih Bukhari 6314; Sahih Muslim 2711

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah Who gave us life after causing us to die (sleep), and unto Him is the resurrection.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah. Say Bismillah before sipping water or milk.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim; sunnah of beginning with Bismillah (Abu Dawud 3767)

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim practice; praising Allah for blessings

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah.

duas.occasion: When someone sneezes (after they praise Allah)
duas.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ
duas.transliteration: Yarhamukallaah
duas.meaning: May Allah have mercy on you.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnee ilma
duas.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma kamaa hassanta khalqee fa hassin khuluqee
duas.meaning: O Allah, as You have made my appearance beautiful, make my character beautiful.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim; Ahmad (hasan according to many scholars)

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhaa wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah Who clothed me with this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaf-tah lee abwaaba rahmatik
duas.meaning: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma sayyiban naafi'an
duas.meaning: O Allah, (make it) a beneficial downpour.

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
duas.meaning: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim; Sahih Bukhari 6115; Sahih Muslim 2610

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee'ul-'Aleem
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing. (Say 3 times morning and evening.)

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheera
duas.meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah — we thank Allah for every blessing.
duas.source: Frequent authentic sunnah; Qur'an encourages Alhamdulillah

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah.

duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh
duas.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdik, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Ant, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk
duas.meaning: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
